additions.name: VNET Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Computing Center — building A1 mechanical, electrical and fit-out works
additions.site_identity_review: Building A1 belongs to the existing VNET Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Computing Center site; it is not a new site. The 24 October 2026 CSCEC item names it '世纪互联乌兰察布零碳智算中心A1楼' (VNET Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Intelligent Computing Center building A1). The same item names the existing Atlas project '世纪互联乌兰察布零碳智算中心基地一期项目A2' (Phase 1 A2 of the same zero-carbon intelligent computing center base). Both carry the same specific campus name, which the site's baseline evidence attaches to this campus: the May 2026 BUCG procurement notice for '世纪互联乌兰察布零碳智算中心基地项目' in the Chahar data-centre park south of Pingzan Street, west of Jing'an South Road, north of Weisi Road and east of Jian'an South Road (evidence 4ce70ae8), and the Inner Mongolia EED Zhilian 220 kV EIA, which names the dedicated substation as part of the same base project (evidence b34dd4ad). The item places A1 'in the Ulanqab high-tech zone' (乌兰察布高新区) and A2 'in the Chahar High-Tech Development Zone'; the Zhilian EIA gives the zone's full name as 乌兰察布察哈尔高新技术开发区 (Ulanqab Chahar High-Tech Development Zone), of which both phrases are short forms. The separately named older VNET 'Cloud and AI Computing Center base' (云智算中心基地, buildings 7# and 11#) several kilometres north-east is a different campus and is not used. The site's only project is Phase 1 A2.

status.summary: On 24 October 2026 CSCEC reported that China Construction Second Engineering Bureau, the M&E general contractor for building A1 of VNET's Ulanqab zero-carbon intelligent computing center, has carried out the installation of low-voltage, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, interior fit-out and roof steel-structure works for the building. It describes A1 as not yet completed: once built, the project will advance the zero-carbon centre. The status is A1's mechanical, electrical and fit-out stage as of the report date. Completion, commissioning tests, final acceptance and operation of A1 are not reported and not asserted. No capacity is given for A1. The neighbouring Phase 1 A2 contract, reported in the same item at final acceptance, is the separate existing project and is not included.

locator.identity_review: This reuses the existing campus point of the VNET Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Computing Center exactly: the published eastern incoming-line endpoint of the campus's dedicated Zhilian No.1 220 kV user substation on the north edge of the base property (Inner Mongolia EED Zhilian 220 kV EIA, evidence b34dd4ad), with its compiled-reference authority, coordinate-transform derivation and unknown-accuracy reason unchanged. status.summary: At the Stafford County Board of Supervisors meeting of 18 August 2026, the Director of Planning and Zoning, presenting the Potomac Church Tech Center proffer amendment for tax map parcel 39-71A, told the Board that the approved site development plan shows two data center buildings and that 'the first building ... was now complete and occupied'; the Board then approved ordinance O26-25 (4-2), which lets the second building be occupied before reclaimed-water lines reach the site. This records Building 1 as complete, and occupied, on 18 August 2026, the meeting day; it is not a completion or occupancy-permit date, which the minutes do not give. Completion covers Building 1 only: the second building's construction stage is not established, and its April 2027 and July 2028 occupancy and finish dates are the applicant's forecasts.

It locates the two-building campus property, not the Building 1 footprint.

status.summary: On 26 August 2026 the Stafford County Planning Commission heard RC24155981, the rezoning of tax map parcels 38-44A, 38-45, 38-45H, 38-45I, 38-45L, 38-73, 38-74A and 38-96 (about 120.88 acres west of Richmond Highway) from A-1, A-2 and B-3 to M-2 'to allow for development of a data center campus' of two two-storey buildings totalling 590,000 square feet, with an on-site electric substation under CUP25156540; the applicant, Falmouth Tech LLC, anticipated a 122 MW power demand. The Commission voted 4-3 to recommend approval of the rezoning, the comprehensive-plan compliance review and the CUP. This records a proposed development identified by a dated county record; the recommendation is not a rezoning decision, site-plan approval or building permit, and the Board's 7 October 2026 hearing outcome is not yet published. The 122 MW figure is requested utility service, not IT load.

additions.site_name: AWS Northeast Creek Technology Campus (North Creek Technology Campus, Louisa County)
additions.name: Northeast Creek Technology Campus 2 — proposed campus phase (major site plan SP20-2026, tax parcel 58-30)

status.summary: Louisa County's Community Development report for September 2026, published in the Board of Supervisors packet of 19 October 2026, lists among new active applications 'Northeast Creek Technology Campus 2 - Major Site Plan - SP20-2026' on tax parcel 58-30 (Mineral District, A-1 in the Technology Overlay District), in first agency review on 11 September 2026. The county's data-center document identifies the North Creek Technology Campus as one of two AWS by-right data-centre campuses in the overlay district, the parcel record lists an Amazon owner, and Amazon Data Services, Inc. is the applicant on the campus's state and federal wetland permits. This records the proposed Campus 2 development as identified by a dated county record on 11 September 2026; site-plan review is not an approval, and no building permit or physical work on parcel 58-30 is asserted.

locator.precision: Planar centroid of Louisa County tax parcel 58 30 (306.27 geodesic acres against 290.13 in the record, about 1591 by 1375 m), the location given for the Campus 2 major site plan. It marks the south-western part of the contiguous Amazon-owned Northeast Creek holdings; the adjoining parcel 58 30C to the north-east, whose centroid is 971 m away, carries the 2998 Jefferson Highway building addresses. It is not a building footprint or the whole campus extent.
locator.identity_review: The county report gives SP20-2026's location as parcel 58-30 in the TOD; the county parcel layer's PIN 58 30 ('GREEN BAY & GUNTER', 290.13 acres, zoning A1) lies 99.9 per cent inside the Technology Overlay District layer and a count-only owner query confirms an Amazon owner. It shares a boundary with Amazon-owned parcel 58 30C, which carries the 17 address points of 2998 Jefferson Highway (Buildings A-N, Z, 1 and 2). Amazon Data Services, Inc.'s Green Bay Farm Road wetland-permit maps (VWP 25-0834, in the county's 8 September 2026 packet) outline the 'Northeast Creek Technology Campus study area boundary (NAO-2024-01939)', and the county's data-center document names the 'AWS North Creek Technology Campus' in the TOD; 'North Creek' and 'Northeast Creek' are treated as the same campus, distinct from the Lake Anna Technology Campus on parcel 30 48 (500 Haley Drive), whose centroid is 15.4 km to the north-east.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The county publishes no positional accuracy for its parcel polygons; the centroid represents a 290-acre parcel within larger contiguous holdings, and the Campus 2 building positions are not documented.
